combo1.title: The Angwitch Fusion Line
combo1.description: A 2-card opener (Angwitch + Mementotlan Fusion) where Angwitch searches Tatsunootoshigo, who mills itself alongside Shleepy and Ghattic. Ghattic then revives itself and retrieves Shleepy to hand, enabling a Contact Fusion into Mementomictlan Tecuhtlica – Creation King, whose on-summon effect mills Akihiron and Dark Blade to set up devastating follow-up plays.

combo2.title: Twin Dragon Loop into Herald of Mirage Lights
combo2.description:
Continuing the Angwitch opening: Mace revives itself from the Graveyard, mills again, and fuels a second Mementotlan Fusion — bringing back Mementomictlan Tecuhtlica – Creation King straight out of the GY.

Tecuhtlica's on-summon mill revives Ghattic (who retrieves Shleepy) and banishes itself to activate the Mementomictlan field spell. Shleepy then special summons itself and fuels a second Fusion into Mementotlan Twin Dragon.

Twin Dragon's own Graveyard trigger sets the field spell off a second time, reviving Goblin, Akihiron, and Shleepy and chaining through a banished Fusion and Goblin's revival effects.

The line closes by Link Summoning Herald of Mirage Lights, reviving Mementotlan-Horned Dragon and Mementoal Tecuhtlica – Combined Creation from the Graveyard, and setting Bone Party, Fusion, and Cranium Burst as backrow for next turn.

combo3.title: Memento into Fiendsmith Splash — Necroquip Princess, Ptolemy M7 & Double Desirae
combo3.description:
Same Angwitch-into-Twin Dragon Memento core, splashed into a full Fiendsmith package. After the Mementomictlan field spell revives Goblin, Akihiron, and Shleepy, Link Summon Moon of the Closed Heaven into Fiendsmith's Requiem, then tribute Requiem to Special Summon Lacrima the Crimson Tears and mill a Fiendsmith Engraver.

Requiem's Graveyard effect fuels a Fusion Summon of Necroquip Princess. The Engraver chain keeps going into an Xyz Summon of Constellar Ptolemy M7, a Fiendsmith's Tract that searches Fabled Lurrie, and a Link Summon of Fiendsmith's Sequence that Fusion Summons Fiendsmith's Desirae.

Sequence and Desirae are sent together to Link Summon Cross-Sheep alongside a revived Mementoal Tecuhtlica – Combined Creation. Cross-Sheep chains into Lacrima once more to Link Summon A Bao A Qu, the Lightless Shadow.

A Bao A Qu mills Bone Party and banishes itself to Fusion Summon a second Fiendsmith's Desirae. The turn ends with Fusion and Cranium Burst set, plus an active Mementomictlan field spell, for a commanding board-and-backrow presence.

combo4.title: Memento K9 Hybrid into Ripper, N.As.H. Knight and Combined Creation
combo4.description: The Angwitch opening taken into a K9 package. Angwitch searches Mementotlan Tatsunootoshigo, which mills Shleepy, Goblin and Mace; Mace revives itself for Mementotlan Fusion into Mementomictlan Tecuhtlica - Creation King, whose mill sets up Ghattic and whose banish adds the Mementomictlan field spell. Shleepy and Ghattic make Mementotlan Twin Dragon, and Akihiron plus a recycled Tatsunootoshigo become K9-17 "Ripper". Jokul and Lantern then add I:P Masquerena and N.As.H. Knight to the board before Mementotlan-Horned Dragon, Mementotlan Bone Party and a second Akihiron revival close on Mementoal Tecuhtlica - Combined Creation, with Mementotlan Fusion, K9-X Forced Release and Bone Party all set.
combo4.credits: ✨ Replay by Canis is a good boy ✨
